messages:
Leah (product): Hey team — we need to lock down a short list + outreach plan for design partners for Redwood Optimize (cost/perf recommendations). goal: recruit 6 partners in 2 weeks for a 6-week pilot. thoughts on fit and incentives?
Tom (growth): Short notes — ideal partner = has >100k monthly tokens, uses embeddings or streaming gen, cares about cost. PLG-friendly startups + 1 mid-market customer. incentive: free Dedicated credits + 3 months of consult time.
Ravi (eng): Agree on perf signal — cpu/gpu mix, median p95 latency, and token cost delta after Optimize. Also need a lightweight SDK hook for experiment telemetry.
Maya (solutions): Suggest adding a success metric for product adoption: 20% of pilot traffic should use the recommendations and we should see >=15% token cost reduction for those flows. Also acceptance criteria: no regressions on quality evals (prompt sets).
Leah (product): Great. Can we make a partner-fit checklist? Quick draft: 1) production usage of LLMs 2) nontrivial token spend 3) willing to run an A/B or canary 4) PO/Eng champion 5) can share prompt sets/metrics 6) legal ok with data access (not necessarily raw data)
Tom (growth): I'll draft invite script. Short + clear ask + low friction. Proposed subject: "Invite: Short pilot on cost + perf tuning with Redwood Optimize"
Tom (growth): Invite body (first-pass):
```
Hi {{name}},
We’re launching a short 6-week pilot of Redwood Optimize — automated batching, cache suggestions, and quantization profiles tuned to reduce token cost while preserving quality. We’re looking for a small set of partners to help shape the product and get early access to Dedicated credits + a technical triage pass.
Commitment: 1-2 syncs over the pilot, share telemetry and simple prompt examples, run a 2-week A/B or canary.
If interested, reply with a quick note about your traffic profile and an eng contact.
Thanks,
Tom (Redwood)
```
Maya (solutions): Tiny tweak: add a line about quality safeguards — we will run prompt-level evals and rollback if quality drops. Helps reassure them.
Ravi (eng): Ops note: need stub API key + telemetry tag (optimize-pilot) so we can filter. Also will push a lightweight flag to the SDK for canary routing.
Leah (product): Perfect. Can we also decide incentives and legal lift? Incentives: 3 months Dedicated credit up to $X, 2 hours/quarter of a Solutions deep-dive, priority onboarding. Legal: require only standard MSA addendum — no long data access commitments.
Tom (growth): I'll send to existing mid-market contacts + run a quick outreach to customers who hit cost alerts in the last 90 days.
Leah (product): Action items: Tom = send invites and track replies in a shared doc; Maya = prepare a one-page onboarding checklist + eval plan; Ravi = SDK flag + telemetry tag; Leah = finalize partner-fit checklist + approval from legal. Deadline: get first 6 replies by 1843270000 (two weeks).
ops-bot: Reminder set for 1843270000 to follow up on pilot invites :calendar:
Tom (growth): noted, will post a candidate list here as replies come in.
Leah (product): Thanks all — keep replies short. we’ll do a 15-min sync Fri to confirm list. :thumbsup:
